title: Interactive Tangram Puzzle Tool
description: A fully responsive interactive tangram puzzle where students drag, rotate, and flip the 7 standard tangram pieces to form target shapes. Adapts layout for mobile (stacked pieces/target), tablet, and desktop (side-by-side). Uses Singularity design system (Poppins font, #4A4DC9 primary, #FF7212 accent, #533086→#FC9145 gradient). Presents 4 progressive challenges: square, triangle, parallelogram, cat.
teaching_notes: Tangrams develop spatial reasoning and geometric intuition. Start with the square (easiest since pieces came from it). The parallelogram requires flipping piece G, which is a key insight. The cat shape challenges creative placement. Connect to the tiling theme: tangram pieces tile the square perfectly. On mobile devices, the layout stacks pieces above the target for easier touch interaction.
instructions_for_student: Solve tangram puzzles by dragging, rotating, and flipping the 7 pieces to fill each target shape. Every piece must be used, with no gaps and no overlaps. Start with the square, then try the triangle, parallelogram, and finally a cat shape!

mobile.features: Icon-only toolbar buttons, compact header, tap/double-tap controls, touch-optimized drag

tablet.layout: stacked or side-by-side based on width

desktop.features: Full UI with all labels, hover states, larger canvas

width.description: Maximum width of the tool container in pixels. The tool is fully responsive within this max-width — it will shrink to fit any smaller container.

height.description: Height of the tool container in pixels. Chrome bars and canvas auto-adjust.

showModeSelector.description: Whether to show mode selection tabs

darkMode.description: Enable dark mode (not used in Singularity design)

additionalProps.description: Tool-specific dynamic content for tangram configuration

targetShape.description: Configuration for each challenge step's target shape

step1.label: Challenge 1: Reconstruct the original square from all 7 pieces

step2.label: Challenge 2: Form a large triangle using all 7 pieces

step3.label: Challenge 3: Form a parallelogram using all 7 pieces

step4.label: Challenge 4: Form a cat shape using all 7 pieces

step1.hintOnFail: Try placing the two large triangles first — they take up half the square.
step1.successMessage: Perfect! All 7 pieces form the original square.

step2.hintOnFail: The large triangles form the base. Try placing them along the bottom edge.
step2.successMessage: Great! You formed a triangle from 7 pieces.

step3.hintOnFail: Remember: the parallelogram piece can be flipped.
step3.successMessage: Excellent! A parallelogram from all 7 tangram pieces.

step4.hintOnFail: Use the small triangles for the ears and the large triangles for the body.
step4.successMessage: Amazing! You made a cat from tangram pieces.

tool_objectives.instructions_for_student: Identify the 7 tangram pieces and arrange them back into the original square. All pieces must be used with no gaps or overlaps.
Form a large triangle using all 7 pieces. Think about which pieces form the base.
Form a parallelogram from all 7 pieces. Remember that piece G can be flipped!
Form a cat shape! Use small triangles for ears, large triangles for the body.

practice.label: Practice
practice.description: Solve tangram puzzles with progressive difficulty
